scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');try{if(fs.existsSync('esm/index.js'))fs.renameSync('esm/index.js','esm/index.mjs');fs.writeFileSync('esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'module' }, null, 2)+'\n')}catch(error){if(error.code!=='ENOENT')throw error}"
scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{ recursive: true, force: true });require('fs').rmSync('esm',{ recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && c8 --all --include=dist/**/*.js --exclude=test/** --exclude=dist/types.js --reporter=text --reporter=text-summary --check-coverage --lines 98 --functions 100 --branches 95 --statements 98 node test/simulator.test.js
